offering_description.value: Distributes maintenance, repair and operating products, including pumps, valves, bearings, fittings and safety supplies, and provides pump repair, fluid handling and inventory management services to industrial plants. Sells mainly to manufacturers and processors through branches, service centers and direct account teams.

primary_products.value: pumps; valves; bearings; power transmission parts; fittings; safety supplies

primary_services.value: pump and rotating equipment repair; fluid handling systems; MRO inventory management; packaging systems integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial manufacturers, oil and gas producers, chemical and petrochemical plants, water utilities, food and beverage processors

end_markets.value: oil and gas; chemicals; water and wastewater; food and beverage; manufacturing; mining

revenue_model.value: product sales: MRO products and equipment sold to plant maintenance teams; service fees: pump repair, fluid handling and inventory management services

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys products from manufacturers and resells them to industrial plants; service provider: repairs equipment and manages customer inventory for industrial plants

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with branches and service centers across both countries

specialization.value: related lines: distribution of MRO products, pump and fluid services, and supply chain management, all serving industrial plants

distribution_channels.value: own locations: branches and service centers near industrial customers; direct sales: account teams serving plant maintenance and purchasing managers; online: online ordering for MRO products

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only normal business rules apply, plus standard workplace safety and product compliance
